description: This file contains TypeScript code for fetching and parsing model information from the Ollama API, including schema definitions, model parsing logic, and API interaction functions.

methods.name: parseOllamaModel
methods.description: Parses raw Ollama model data into a ModelInfo object, considering context window and capabilities.

methods.name: getOllamaModels
methods.description: Fetches available Ollama models from the API, filters for models supporting native tools, and returns a record of ModelInfo objects.
